plain_english: Churned subscribers have lower tenure months on average (churned: 18.0, retained: 37.6). The difference is statistically significant (t-test p = 0.0000), with a large effect (Cohen's d = -0.852). Correlation only — no causal claim is made.

Churned subscribers have higher monthly charge on average (churned: 74.4, retained: 61.3). The difference is statistically significant (t-test p = 0.0000), with a small effect (Cohen's d = 0.446). Correlation only — no causal claim is made.
